prompts.idle: Create production character sprites for American Girl Doll Race. The reference is the APPROVED MIRA DOLL. Preserve her exact identity and outfit: Korean-inspired rounded molded vinyl doll face, brown inset almond eyes, small knowing smile, chunky 18-inch play-doll proportions, very long straight hot-pink twin ponytails with face-framing strands, black short-sleeve shirt with silver embellished shoulders and small pale abstract graphic, golden-yellow pleated skirt with black belt/silver chain and pink tassel charm, black fingerless gloves, black knee-high lace boots with pink trim and laces. Maintain consistent face, hair, garment details, head/torso/limb scale across EVERY pose. Realistic rooted hair and sewn miniature fabric, smooth vinyl toy limbs, warm soft studio light. EXACTLY 3 equal square cells in one 3:1 horizontal strip. One full doll per cell with clear transparent margin on all sides; all long ponytails, hands and boots fully visible within their own cell, no overlap or cropping. True transparent background, no scene/floor/shadows/halo/gradient, no labels/grid/lettering. No weapon or other prop. Movement faces RIGHT in a slight three-quarter view. Personality: poised, cool, athletic dancer, quietly playful and self-assured; confident expressions rather than generic cheerfulness. Three relaxed idles: cell 1 neutral confident stand, arms relaxed, both feet grounded; cell 2 subtle weight shift and a knowing smile, feet grounded; cell 3 one hand on hip, a slight head tilt and cool amused smile, feet grounded. Keep the SAME standing height and feet baseline.
